content:
Apple has today released the watchOS 27.0.1 update for the Apple Watch. The company says that the update addresses an issue that was causing some Apple Watch devices to unexpectedly restart. The update is only available to Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users.

Below is the full release announcement for watchOS 27.0.1:

On Reddit and other forums, some Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users reported that their new watch would randomly restart several times a day. While not all users were affected, there was clearly a problem, and hopefully today's software update will fix it.

Have you experienced any issues with your Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4? Feel free to share them with us in the comments.
